Class ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.aot.bytecode.ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry
Enclosing class:
ClassPathTransform.Result
@Internal public static final class ClassPathTransform.Result.Entry extends Object
What the strip step did to one jar. Every class of the jar is counted once, as stripped, unchanged or fallen back.
Since:
3.2.0
